summary: Fix correctly resolves the issue: constructor now allows non-disjoint cycles (across-cycle duplicates) while still rejecting duplicates in non-cycle array-form input, matching the requested behavior of identity permutation from [[0,1],[0,1]].

issues.description: Duplicate-check is now entirely skipped for is_cycle=True, since it operates on the flattened list of all cycle args; this also silently permits a malformed duplicate within a single cycle (e.g. Permutation([[0,1,0]])) rather than only permitting duplicates across separate cycles. Edge case, not the scenario in the bug report.
